title: Convex Order Beyond Dimension One: Projection Tests, Counterexamples and Gaussian Mixtures
summary: In actuarial science and quantitative finance, convex order provides a natural way to compare risks with the same mean. In dimension one, convex order is well understood through several characterisations. In higher dimensions, a natural approach is to compare all one-dimensional projections, but, although necessary, the resulting condition is in general not sufficient for multivariate convex order.
